definition_notes.housing_units: DCA glossary: a rental or for-sale dwelling unit authorized by a construction permit.
definition_notes.new_construction: DCA glossary: permit type authorizing the start of a new structure.
definition_notes.net_new_housing_units: DCA glossary: difference between new-construction housing units authorized and housing units demolished.
definition_notes.square_feet: DCA glossary: estimated building area reported on permits for new construction and additions.
definition_notes.legacy_municipality_handling: Governed current-municipality normalization: Princeton Borough 1109 excluded and source row 1110 emitted as current Princeton 1114; Pine Valley 0429 excluded; Pahaquarry 2118 excluded; 9999 State Buildings excluded. Princeton/Pine Valley handling is source-explicit; Pahaquarry dissolution is confirmed by the NJ Division of Taxation Assessors Handbook.
